title: calendar_event
description: A calendar event exactly as GET /api/v1/calendar-feeds/events returns it (OpenSpec calendar-event-edits). rev and access are present only for an event of a connected calendar; the title is text from the remote calendar.

rev.description: the version of the event the command saw; every change is conditional on it

reason.description: why it cannot be changed: edits_off, calendar_read_only, recurring, guests, not_organizer or refresh_pending

time.description: HH:MM wall time; absent for an all-day event

tz.description: IANA zone; absent for a floating or all-day event
